session: Marcus Lee, session 2 with Daniel Okafor

segments.text: Where would you like to start today?
The handover review with Leah. I said the report was fine when it wasn't, and then I fixed it myself on Friday night.
What stopped you from telling her what you saw?
I think I see feedback as criticism. If I say it, I'm the bad guy. If I fix it, nobody has to feel bad.
And what does fixing it yourself cost the team?
Leah doesn't learn what good looks like, and I lose my Friday evenings. The same thing happened with the depot rota last month.
What could you try before we next meet?
In Wednesday's one-to-one with Leah, I'll tell her one specific thing about the report and ask how she'd change it. Maybe also something with the depot team, I'm not sure yet.
